decision.DROP: Playful turn absent, motive-consistency below 4, or conflict with a core sensitivity. Log reaction_event{outcome:pregate_drop}. Do not retry the same identity; evaluator penalizes the operator. Failed attempts actively harm status and liking.
decision.PASS: Playful turn present and motive-consistency >= 6. Predicts the 96% success class. Compile beats.
decision.REFRAME: Turn present but consistency marginal or conflicted. One retry: keep contradiction_span, change target_stance (down to lateral or self_deprecation), switch motive type (reward to relief: lighten framing), or anchor relevance to prior conversation. Re-run; still below 6 means DROP.

definitions.motive_consistency: The turn is consistent with what this audience wants now — good for us, not benign in general. Mixed motives dilute mirth.
definitions.playful_turn: Rapid shift of identity (person, object, situation, statement) from more-serious to less-serious. Speed matters; stock turns work. Must END playful — a turn ending serious (failure, illness) is not one.

humor_types.relief: Aversive motive: lighten a threat. Required framing in difficult times (86% of relief jokes land there).
humor_types.reward: Appetitive motive: prolong good times (65% land in good times). Reframe to relief when the room is struggling.

note: Mined 2026-10-08 from play-mirth theory (Frontiers 2024): mirth iff playful turn perceived AND motive-consistent, simultaneously (conjunction 96% vs 1%, V=0.95). Runs BEFORE the Director compiles beats, as a cheap LLM judge in the HumorBench autograder pattern. Taboo allowed only as relief humor in difficult times with self_deprecation or critique stance plus high familiarity; else reframe to object/wordplay or drop.
reads: audience want plus emotional state (reward vs relief selection and timing)

thresholds.timing: In difficult times require relief type; in good times reward is native.
